notes.title: Devlog #6 – Smarter, Scarier, Smoother Hordes
notes.content:
[h3][b]New: Shambler AI Movement[/b][/h3][p]We’ve overhauled enemy movement for our standard zombie units.
They now [b]shuffle, stumble, and truly shamble[/b] their way toward you — giving off that slow-creeping horror feel while still posing a real threat in numbers.[/p][p]This new "shamble-walk" blend replaces the old default navigation and adds unsettling realism to how basic infected close the gap. It’s subtle, but deeply immersive.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CSOwLHNVmmM;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Horde Behavior Rework[/b][/h3][p]Surviving the first 60 seconds used to be easy. Not anymore.
We’ve introduced [b]tiered horde escalation[/b] — enemies don’t just increase in number, they get smarter and faster over time. You’ll feel the pressure build, wave after wave.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Radioactive Zombie Reactions[/b][/h3][p]The radioactive variants now [b]visibly react to your attacks[/b].
We’ve added a [b]new take-damage animation[/b], making combat more satisfying and readable when these volatile enemies get hit. Expect clearer visual feedback as they soak up your firepower.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Regeneration System + Healing Text FX[/b][/h3][p]Healing is now more than just a number ticking up.[/p][list][*][p][b]Regeneration mechanics[/b] now heal based on a [b]percentage of your max health[/b] every few seconds, rather than a flat rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Floating [b]green healing numbers[/b] now appear above your survivor — clean, readable, and non-intrusive.[/p][/*][*][p]The healing FX no longer block clicks or menus and are timed to show only meaningful amounts.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576283/685ddc9acfacdef3e1e64834d3eec2ab48023afb.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Safehouse Upgrade Systems Confirmed Working[/b][/h3][p]We’ve confirmed that all Safehouse meta-upgrades — like [b]damage boosts, move speed, and healing rate[/b] — correctly apply at runtime and [b]stack cleanly with in-run passives[/b].
This means you now truly feel stronger across runs as you invest in permanent upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576283/106e8f41a2791486ef3e4a473a7e94e11488a490.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Other Core Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]selected character now persists[/b] properly across all scenes and carries their upgrades into the run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attack Speed upgrades[/b] now function correctly across weapons — including RadialBurst and Boomerang Axe — and don't cause unintended slowdowns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating UI elements that blocked menus or cluttered the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the backend for [b]stat tracking, health regeneration, and passive upgrade stacking[/b], laying the groundwork for future survivors and enemies.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Coming Soon[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Extraction mechanics and permadeath handling.[/p][/*][*][p]New characters and map environments.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss variants, weapon evolutions, and more responsive UI polish.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think — and stay vigilant.
[b]The protocol only delays the inevitable.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Pathfinding, Fading, and Boss Brains: July Devlog
notes.content:
[h3]🧠 Smarter Zombies: Pathfinding Overhaul Complete[/h3][p]No more zombies dumbly faceplanting into walls.[/p][list][*][p][b]New A* Grid System:[/b] Custom-built from scratch to handle huge zombie swarms without lag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Obstacle Padding Logic:[/b] Prevents enemies from hugging colliders. Looks better, plays smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombie Collisions Disabled:[/b] Forget the awkward crowd-stuck shuffles — they pass through each other now, fluid and deadly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Script Cleanup:[/b] Obsolete systems like ZombiePathScheduler are gone. Simpler logic = better performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]Performance? We tested this thing on hordes [i]hundreds strong[/i] — smooth like decapitated butter. 🧈🧟[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌐 Dynamic World: Occlusion-Based Tilemap Fading[/h3][p]Who turned out the lights? Oh, it was a tree.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Scene:[/b] RuralAmericana_01 — your first taste of the overgrown apocalypse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tilemap Layers:[/b] Ground, Props, Colliders, and now [b]FadeableProps[/b] — smart environment rendering that fades when the player walks behind obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom Shader + Script:[/b] A TilemapFader uses player proximity to dynamically alpha-fade occluding tiles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sorting by Y-Axis:[/b] Implemented camera-based sorting for pixel-perfect layering.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s not just pretty — it’s readable. No more losing your survivor behind a bush.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Settings That Actually Stick[/h3][p]Options menus shouldn’t suck. Ours don’t.[/p][list][*][p][b]Volume Sliders:[/b] Music & SFX with FMOD support, saved with PlayerPrefs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution Dropdowns:[/b] Duplicates filtered out, fullscreen toggle works right.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Prefab:[/b] Works across main menu & pause menu — modular and reskinned with full pixel art polish.[/p][/*][/list][p]Got a CRT or a 4K ultrawide? We got you.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]☣️ Boss Brain Boosts[/h3][p]We’ve revisited the [b]Radioactive Furnace[/b] — your bile-spewing bullet-hell nemesis.[/p][list][*][p][b]Attack Patterns Finalized:[/b] AcidSpit, ProjectileBurst, WallBarrage, and SpiralBlast now rotate cleanly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summon Phase Logic:[/b] Boss becomes invincible, spawns minions, turns [i]green with envy (and poison)[/i] until you kill them all.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Polished:[/b] All FX pooled, no lag spikes, and the visuals drip with radioactive flair.[/p][/*][/list][p]This boss doesn’t just challenge you — it tests your ability to survive a [i]tactical nightmare[/i].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 What’s Brewing in the Lab[/h3][p]Future targets — because this undead machine never stops mutating:[/p][list][*][p]🧱 Finish arena lockdown system for proper boss fights.[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 Build the Safe House for meta-progression (upgrades, currency, unlocks).[/p][/*][*][p]🔓 Implement extraction logic + victory triggers.[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 Optimize pathfinding further using flow fields or spatial partitioning.[/p][/*][*][p]💾 Add save system for Contagion Credits and unlocks.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💀 Join the Plague Parade[/h3][p]Every wishlist, follow, and comment pushes this solo-dev dream further into the necrotic light.[/p][p]Made with no studio, no publisher — just code, caffeine, and a pile of zombie parts.[/p][p]🖤 Wishlist the game
📢 Follow for updates
🧠 Drop feedback — your ideas fuel the swarm[/p][p]Until next time — stay sharp, stay sick, and don’t stop running.[/p][p][b]– Para82[/b][/p]

notes.title: ☢️ Devlog #4 — Radioactive Horrors Unleashed
notes.content:
Hey survivors! 💀

Welcome to another scorching update from the pixelated apocalypse that is Contagion Protocol — our zombie-infested bullet-hell roguelite built with pure grit, heavy metal, and caffeine. This month, the horde mutated. Let’s break it down.

[previewyoutube=0x30LQPh8TA;full][/previewyoutube]

🧟‍♂️ New Enemy Type: Radioactive Zombie
They don’t just bite — they spit.

- Ranged Acid Attacks: These green-glowing freaks stay at a distance and fire toxic projectiles toward the player.

- Projectile Logic: Acid orbs deal damage, glow with animated FX, and destroy themselves after a short lifespan.

- Directional AI: Enemies now rotate and face the player correctly, with idle animations updated to avoid twitching.

- Fully Integrated: These spitters are bombable, freezable, knockback-able, and death-animatable, thanks to full IDamageable support.

- Visuals: AcidFX on death. Glowing toxic puke when they go down.  ☠️

🧪 Boss Encounter: The Radioactive Nightmare
The first real boss has arrived — and it's dripping with bile.

- Multi-phase Behavior: Uses custom RadioactiveBossAI.cs for complex attacks.

- Acid Spit Attack: Instantiates a spitting projectile that leaves behind a damage-over-time acid puddle.

- Animation Precision: Boss flip direction and FX spawn points dynamically adjust based on movement direction.

- Pooling-Ready: Every acid puddle, spit FX, and blood spray is optimized to avoid runtime lag.

- Currently Static Spawn: Boss doesn’t spawn from the usual system — it’s manually placed for testing (expect spawning upgrades soon).

⚠️ Debugging the Apocalypse
A month of hard bug-smashing and polish.

🛠️ Projectile Direction Fixes: Acid orbs now fly correctly — no more frozen fireballs hanging in mid-air.

🔧 Animator Fixes: Added missing idle directions to avoid twitch loops.

💥 FX Cleanup: Blood and acid FX properly despawn and pool without memory leaks.

🔁 Interface Consistency: IDamageable and IFreezable logic now fully respected across all enemy types.

✅ Flip Logic Refactor: SpriteRenderer flipX is now used instead of localScale — better visuals and less jank.

📈 Architecture Deep Dive for all you Nerds
Because systems should scale — not break.

- Modular Boss AI: Uses a clean SpawnAcidSpit() pipeline, including prefab offsets and visual sync.

- Prefab Hierarchies: All visual elements are children under empty GameObjects for clean separation (Collider, FX, Visuals).

- Animator Best Practices: Every state (Idle, Attack, Death) now exists in 8 directions. No more “Missing State” spam.

- Spawner System Extension: Acid zombies are now injected into waves after 4 minutes. Boss spawning still manual for now.

🛠️ What’s Coming Next
The cauldron still boils.

🌪️ Add Boss Spawner Logic to the zombie wave system.

☣️ Polish acid puddle FX with screen shake and damage ticks.

🔥 Implement Projectile Variants (spread, spores, etc).

🧠 Build out a RangedZombieAI base class for cleaner code reuse.

🧩 Finalize Boss Attacks 2, 3 & 4: Skull pulse and poison nova, as well as pulsing cicular acid balls

💾 Integrate proper pooling for all boss FX and attacks.

🙌 Thank You for the Support

Every wishlist, follow, and comment makes this game crawl closer to the surface.

Contagion Protocol is made with love, obsession, and late-night debugging sessions. There’s no studio. No funding. Just one dev and a dream to make something sick, stylish, and brutally fun.

If you’re vibing with this journey:

🖤 Wishlist the game
📢 Follow for more
🎤 Drop a comment — your feedback fuels this fire

Until next time, stay radioactive. 🤘

– Para82

notes.title: Devlog #3 — Bombs, Freeze, and Tactical Mayhem
notes.content:
🧟 Devlog #3 — Bombs, Freeze, and Tactical Mayhem

Hey survivors! 🤘

Welcome back to another update on the development of Contagion Protocol — the pixel-art zombie-slaying bullet hell roguelike fueled by heavy metal and early-morning hustle. Let’s dive into the latest chaos we’ve been building:

🎮 Major Progress & Gameplay Updates

⚡ New Tactical Pickups: Bombs & Freeze Potions

- Bomb Pickup: Instantly annihilates all zombies on screen. Massive screen flash + slow-motion effect for that satisfying “oh sht”* moment.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45576283/a6b343ee085de9042567bfff5ec6fc1b53dfe224.gif[/img]

- Freeze Potion: Freezes all zombies solid for 5 seconds — giving you critical breathing room to reposition and punish.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45576283/5670983f83a93e99ebe7fd60d10dfdcaa0451c11.gif[/img]

Details:

- 1 in 20 zombies drop a Bomb or Freeze Potion (random chance).

- Only one pickup can exist at a time.

- 30-second cooldowns after pickups to keep balance.

- These pickups add huge tactical depth without overcomplicating your core gameplay.

🎬 Screen Flash & Slow Motion Polish

- Bomb pickups now trigger a full-screen flash using an optimized Canvas system.

- After the flash, a smooth 0.4 second slow-motion window kicks in, making your multi-kill moments feel massive.

- Freeze Potion properly halts both zombie movement and animation speed — without breaking death animations.

- Big kills = big feels. Exactly what a survival shooter needs.

🩸 Blood FX Optimization

Blood FX now auto-despawns after 20 seconds and is fully pooled.

- This fixes memory leaks and prevents late-game lag, even when you’re racking up thousands of kills.

- Polish matters — and this was a major step toward making Contagion Protocol buttery smooth.

📈 Zombie Spawner & Scaling Enhancements

- Early gameplay now focuses on slow zombies to help players build momentum.

- After 90 seconds, faster zombies begin sneaking into the horde.

- Enemy health and speed scale dynamically over time to keep tension rising.

- We’re setting the stage for special zombies, elite variants, and bosses in the near future.

🛠️ Core System Improvements

- XP Shards and blood effects fully pooled to stabilize memory usage.

- GameManager cleanup: Better handling of pickups, weapon management, and scene transitions.

- Modular Pickup System: Bombs and Freeze Potions are now built modularly, meaning new pickups like Magnets (vacuum XP!) will be easy to add soon.

- Screen Flash Manager: Visual effects optimized to avoid CPU/GPU overhead.

🐞 Bugs Crushed

- Fixed a nasty Main Menu bug where player references weren’t properly cleaned up after death.

- Solved issues with bullet trails spawning incorrectly on weapon fire.

- FreezePotion correctly respects death animations even while frozen.

- Every bug fixed = smoother runs = happier survivors. 💀

📅 What’s Next?

- Implementing the Magnet Pickup to vacuum up XP shards instantly.

- Designing new weapon types and synergy systems for deeper build variety.

- Preparing to add elite zombies and horde pulses to break up endless flow.

- Starting level design on Map 1 — gritty city streets filled with chaos.

- Still grinding toward a playable demo for Steam Next Fest — stay tuned for big news there soon!

🙌 Why Your Support Matters

Every wishlist, follow, and comment fuels this journey.
Contagion Protocol is being built the hard way — early mornings, late nights, and fueled by pure passion (and coffee ☕).
There are no paywalls here. No gimmicks. Just a hardcore survival game crafted for players who love chaos, blood, and brutal heavy metal.

Thanks for sticking with me. The apocalypse is just getting started. 🤘

🖤 Wishlist the game.
📢 Follow for more updates.
🎤 Drop a comment — your feedback means the world.

Stay brutal,

– Para82

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 — Unleashing Chaos
notes.content:
🧟 Devlog #2 — Weapons, Bugs, and Heavy Metal

Hey survivors! 🤘

Welcome back to the second devlog for Contagion Protocol, the heavy-metal zombie-crushing roguelike. Development is still rolling full steam ahead (early mornings and late nights!), and here's what I've been hammering out since our last update:

[previewyoutube=7An_gmZigAo;full][/previewyoutube]

🎮 Major Progress & Updates:

⚔️ Weapon Systems & Gameplay Improvements:

- Orbiting Cleaver has been polished! It now cleanly spawns additional blades as you level up (capped at 5 blades). Each blade evenly spaces out around your character, ensuring smooth rotation and satisfying zombie carnage.

- Refined weapon behaviors for Reverse Shotgun and Radial Burst—both now correctly scale their fire rates with your passive AttackSpeed stat.

- Bullet lifespans and damage outputs are now consistent and easily adjustable per weapon, ensuring a balanced experience.

🔧 Core Game Management Improvements:

- Significant cleanup of GameManager logic: smoother weapon instantiation, better handling of upgrades, and runtime adjustments to equipped weapons and passives.

- Fixed a tricky bug where passive upgrades weren't consistently affecting bullet-based weapons. Now your upgrades pack the punch they promise!

🎵 Music & Audio Enhancements:

- Added custom fade durations and crossfading between looping tracks, but encountered (and currently debugging!) some issues where Main Menu music doesn’t trigger correctly in the built game. Audio debugging is underway, and it's top priority!

- Level-up music stings now correctly trigger, giving each upgrade selection an impactful feel.

🐞 Bug Squashing & Optimization:

- Addressed major bugs related to returning to the Main Menu after death: previously, characters would disappear and buttons broke. Now the GameManager properly cleans up stale references, ensuring clean transitions between scenes.

- Improved stability of zombie spawning waves, preparing the system for future "Horde Waves" that will trigger special dynamic heavy-metal tracks.

📅 What’s Next?

- Resolving the audio issues for crossfades and Main Menu music playback is priority number one.

- Implementing dynamic music changes during intense waves and boss encounters.

- Continuing work on additional weapons, traits, and exciting visual/audio feedback on upgrades.

- Preparing the first playable demo aiming for Steam Next Fest later this year!

🙌 Why Your Support Matters

- Every wishlist, follow, and comment fuels the passion and determination behind this project. I'm fully committed to delivering a game that's rewarding, chaotic, and drenched in heavy metal—without DLC or paywalls.

- Thanks for following the journey of Contagion Protocol. Keep the ideas and feedback coming—I’m listening to every one of you.

Stay brutal,

– Para82 🤘

notes.title: Devlog #1 — From Duty to Development
notes.content:
🧟 Devlog #1 — From Duty to Development

Hey everyone 👋

Welcome to the very first devlog for Contagion Protocol — a solo-developed, heavy-metal, zombie-crushing roguelike built in the cracks of real life.

My name is Jakob or Para82 and I’m currently active-duty military — an airborne infantryman by day, solo game developer by night (and very early morning). This game is a passion project I work on before sunrise and after my kids go to bed. It’s a grind — but it’s the dream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576283/d7622e06bf322c44ff83e7756829032901355d41.png[/img]

🎮 What is Contagion Protocol?

Contagion Protocol is a brutal, stylish pixel roguelike built for that feeling we all chase after a long day — log in, turn your brain off, and just obliterate waves of zombies to a nasty metal soundtrack.

Inspired by games like Vampire Survivors, Death Must Die, and my love for post-apocalyptic zombie novels (The Extinction Cycle, etc.), this game is meant to be:

- Easy to pick up

- Rewarding instantly

- Full of chaos, gore, progression, and replayability

- Something that just feels good to play

The music inspiration? That’s all my wife. She loves heavy metal (so do I), and said your game will be brutal and dark, the music should match it, so I thought — why not fuse all of this together?

✍️ Why I’m Making This Game

I’ve always loved the idea of developing a game for PC — I graduated with a B.S. in Software Development in 2019 and even released a tiny mobile game back then. But then life happened: military, kids, responsibilities. One day, my wife asked, “What do you want to do after you retire from the army?” I told her: I want to make games. She looked at me and said: “Then why don’t you start now?”

So, I did.

I wake up at 0400 to work on this before my day job. At night, after family time, I squeeze in a couple more hours. Weekends, holidays, whenever I can grab the time — I’m building this thing. And I’m not stopping until it’s everything I want it to be.

🧠 What Makes This Game Different?

- I want to push the zombie-survival roguelike idea further:

- Permadeath characters — if you lose them, you have to find them again

- Unlockable survivors scattered throughout the world

- Various biomes — cities, farmlands, and beyond

- 20+ unique zombies, each with their own chaos

- Endless mode, brutal bosses, weapon evolutions

- No DLC. No paywalls. Ever. Everything I add will be free.

I'm aiming for a gritty, replayable, metal-drenched apocalypse where every run feels earned — and every death gets personal.

The Plan Going Forward:

- First public demo: June or October Steam Next Fest

- Early Access target: Q1 2026

- Frequent devlogs & updates between now and then

- Roadmap coming soon (that’ll be Devlog #2!)

This game will be under $5. If it takes 2, 3, or even 4 years to make it amazing — I’ll do it. I want this to be a gem.

🫱 Why You Should Wishlist & Follow
Because I care. I care about games. I care about gamers. I care about finishing what I start.

I’ve seen too many developers disappear or lock everything behind a paywall. That’s not me. I’m building this with love — and I want to bring the community in as I go. You’ll see the evolution of this game, and maybe a bit of me chasing a dream after active duty life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576283/6b7b81b46e590b4d9b42722f39c1e11740e4733b.png[/img]

If you’re reading this:
Thanks for being here early.
Thanks for supporting indie devs.
And thanks for helping me build Contagion Protocol into something unforgettable.

Let’s crush some zombies soon. 🤘

– Para82

🖤 Wishlist the game.
📢 Follow for devlogs & progress.
🎤 And drop a comment if you’ve got thoughts, ideas, or just wanna say hi.
